name: Lunar two-body gravity trajectory in linked mover
purpose: Verify point gravity is reached through the configured production mover.
configuration: No-SPICE neutral Na; initial circular orbit at 3 lunar radii; 1200 s with dt=20 s.
procedure: Advance with production mover and compare final six-state to the analytical orbit.
expected_pass_result: Trajectory follows the closed-form lunar orbit.
status_semantics: PASS requires the linked mover trajectory; a gravity-kernel PASS alone is insufficient.
